steps.en: Put the whole skill folder into your agent's skills directory and run the install check
steps.zh: 把整个 skill 目录放进 agent 的技能目录，跑一次安装检查

component.zh: 协议 + 配方 + 脚本

steps.en: Say what to draw and name a style by number, Chinese name or English alias
steps.zh: 说出要画什么，用编号、中文名或英文别名指定画风
steps.code: 用吉卜力风画一只在下雨天打伞的猫

steps.en: Resolves the style; if you named none, it shows the menu and waits for your pick
steps.zh: 定位画风；没指定时列出菜单，等你来选

steps.en: Copies that recipe out verbatim and fills the bracketed slots from your description
steps.zh: 原样取出该配方，按你的描述填好方括号空位

steps.en: Returns one copyable prompt — or, for styles 3.1/19/20, a JSON bundle with anchor images
steps.zh: 交回一段可复制的提示词；3.1/19/20 号则是带锚点图的 JSON 调用包

steps.en: Paste it into your own image model and generate
steps.zh: 贴进你自己的生图模型出图

value.en: The look you validated once is reproduced word for word every time — no re-assembling style prompts, no agent rewording it
value.zh: 验证过一次的画风每次都逐字复现——不用再拼画风提示词，也不怕 agent 改写
